answer: Diploma hash with university attestation is the check: a diploma whose hash matches the university record. A farm faking 328 aliases needs 328 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuing authority each epoch, and a revoked or missing entry loses the seat. Call it the lantern rule: fakes pay per head, the honest pay once, the lotus record is open for audit, and the quill window is too short for 328 aliases to earn their price back.
